q.stadium: How do I add my pitch?

a.booking: In Pitches choose a pitch, a day and an hour, then pay by card. Need several hours? Book each one separately.
a.cancel: My games → booking → “Cancel”. The refund is shown on the booking page before you cancel — it depends on the pitch's cancellation terms and how long is left before the game. The money goes back to your card.
a.cash: If the pitch allows a deposit, you pay only part of the price when booking. Pay the rest in cash at the pitch on the day, or by card in the app with “Pay the rest”.
a.teams: In My team create a team and invite friends with the invite link. The captain picks a time and looks for an opponent; when another team accepts, the game is confirmed and the pitch price is split between the teams.
a.stadium: Profile → “Add a pitch”. Fill in the details and send — the pitch is reviewed, and once approved players can see it. Then switch to owner mode from Profile.

general.title: General
general.text: MiniPolya is an online booking service for football pitches in Tashkent. By using the app you agree to these terms.

booking.title: Booking and payment
booking.text: A booking is confirmed once it is paid. You pay the price shown when booking; there are no extra charges.

cancel.title: Cancelling and refunds
cancel.text: Each pitch's cancellation terms are shown on the booking page. The refund is shown before you cancel.

owners.title: Pitch owners
owners.text: Owners are responsible for accurate pitch details, prices and opening hours. Pitches are visible to players only after approval.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If these terms change, the new version is published on this page.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.text: Your Telegram id, the first name, last name and phone you enter, and your booking and payment history.

use.title: Why
use.text: To make bookings and payments, so the pitch owner can reach you, and to send notifications.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.text: The owner of a pitch you book sees your name and phone. Card details are kept only by the payment provider — we never see them.

keep.title: How long
keep.text: Data is kept for as long as the service needs it to work.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For questions about your data, write to the support chat in Help.
